title: The session-start hook reads a repo's visibility correctly
why: The session-start hook prints "repo caution: public" for private repos. Measured Nov 1 19:30-19:52 CST: degen and joyous are private (gh api .private is true), but the hook said public, and a degen lane built a wrong premise on it, about spend.
note: Hook file(s) found by grep "repo caution": /home/user/claude-settings/hooks/session_start.sh /home/user/claude-settings/hooks/test_session_start.py . Red first: a fixture private repo prints private; a public one prints public; a read that fails prints unknown, never public (verification-report-unknown-reads). Port: yes, the hook runs in every session. Ready: no open question.
